{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FirmwareAuth where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Crypto.Hash (SHA256(..), hashWith, Digest)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)

type DeviceId = ByteString
type ServiceId = ByteString
type Nonce = ByteString
type Signature = ByteString
type SharedSecret = ByteString

data AuthRequest = AuthRequest
  { arDeviceId  :: DeviceId
  , arServiceId :: ServiceId
  , arTimestamp :: Word64
  , arNonce     :: Nonce
  , arPayload   :: ByteString
  , arSignature :: Signature
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuthState = AuthState
  { asSecrets    :: Map DeviceId SharedSecret
  , asUsedNonces :: IORef (Map ServiceId [NonceEntry])
  , asClockSkew  :: Word64
  }

data NonceEntry = NonceEntry
  { neNonce     :: Nonce
  , neTimestamp :: Word64
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

maxNonceAge :: Word64
maxNonceAge = 300

nonceWindowSize :: Int
nonceWindowSize = 1024

computeHMAC :: SharedSecret -> ByteString -> Signature
computeHMAC secret msg =
  let ipad = BS.map (`xor` 0x36) (padKey secret)
      opad = BS.map (`xor` 0x5c) (padKey secret)
      inner = convert (hashWith SHA256 (BS.append ipad msg)) :: ByteString
      outer = convert (hashWith SHA256 (BS.append opad inner)) :: ByteString
  in outer
  where
    padKey k
      | BS.length k > 64 = BS.append (convert (hashWith SHA256 k) :: ByteString) (BS.replicate (64 - 32) 0)
      | otherwise = BS.append k (BS.replicate (64 - BS.length k) 0)
    xor a b = a `xorW` b
    xorW :: Word8 -> Word8 -> Word8
    xorW = (\x y -> fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral x :: Int) `mod` ((fromIntegral y :: Int) + 256))

constantTimeCompare :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = BS.foldl' (\acc (x, y) -> acc && (x == y)) True (BS.zip a b)

serializeForSigning :: AuthRequest -> ByteString
serializeForSigning req = BS.concat
  [ arDeviceId req
  , arServiceId req
  , BC.pack (show (arTimestamp req))
  , arNonce req
  , arPayload req
  ]

verifyTimestamp :: AuthState -> Word64 -> IO Bool
verifyTimestamp state reqTime = do
  now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime
  let diff = if now > reqTime then now - reqTime else reqTime - now
  return (diff <= asClockSkew state)

checkAndRecordNonce :: AuthState -> ServiceId -> NonceEntry -> IO Bool
checkAndRecordNonce state sid entry = do
  nonceMap <- readIORef (asUsedNonces state)
  let entries = Map.findWithDefault [] sid nonceMap
  now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime
  let validEntries = filter (\e -> now - neTimestamp e < maxNonceAge) entries
  let isDuplicate = any (\e -> neNonce e == neNonce entry) validEntries
  if isDuplicate
    then return False
    else do
      let newEntries = take nonceWindowSize (entry : validEntries)
      writeIORef (asUsedNonces state) (Map.insert sid newEntries nonceMap)
      return True

verifySignature :: AuthState -> AuthRequest -> IO Bool
verifySignature state req = do
  case Map.lookup (arDeviceId req) (asSecrets state) of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just secret -> do
      let msg = serializeForSigning req
      let expected = computeHMAC secret msg
      return (constantTimeCompare (arSignature req) expected)

authenticateRequest :: AuthState -> AuthRequest -> IO (Either String ())
authenticateRequest state req = do
  tsValid <- verifyTimestamp state (arTimestamp req)
  if not tsValid
    then return (Left "timestamp outside acceptable window")
    else do
      sigValid <- verifySignature state req
      if not sigValid
        then return (Left "invalid signature")
        else do
          let entry = NonceEntry (arNonce req) (arTimestamp req)
          nonceOk <- checkAndRecordNonce state (arServiceId req) entry
          if not nonceOk
            then return (Left "nonce already used")
            else return (Right ())

crossServiceForward :: AuthState -> AuthRequest -> ServiceId -> IO (Either String AuthRequest)
crossServiceForward state req targetService = do
  result <- authenticateRequest state req
  case result of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right () -> do
      let forwarded = req { arServiceId = targetService }
      return (Right forwarded)
